privileged_info_for_vlm: The root directory must be /home/ga/Documents/InspectionDocs/. Required subfolders are OSHA, FEMA, and General. Required domains for PDFs are osha.gov, fema.gov (or usfa.fema.gov), and one other .gov site (e.g., epa.gov, hud.gov, nist.gov). The manifest must be on the Desktop and include filename, source URL, a one-line description for each of the 3 files, and a total count.
